title: Next steps, stalled deals and negotiation trades
origin: ClimbOS synthesis (original proposal) from the member frameworks; author guidance is cited by finding id, proposed rules are labelled 'proposed'.
decision_task: When to close a stalled deal as lost, and how to negotiate by trading rather than giving discounts.
applies_when: Buyer asks for a discount or better terms
exclusions: Deals with no agreed next step yet (run BKP-15 first)
required_inputs: Deal history with dated next steps
evidence_requirements: kept vs broken commitments (missed meetings, unanswered agreed deliverables)
explicit buyer statements about timing or permission to re-contact
owner's list price, floor price and margin (shared/analysis/decisions.ts margin/priceFloor)
which terms the owner is willing to vary
competitor quote if claimed (seen, not assumed)
missing_data_behavior: No CRM: owner lists open deals and last contact.

decision_branches.then: One clarity email, then close lost with a reason.
Trade for upfront cash, term or scope; payment-term premium computed in code.

implementation_steps: State the next step, owner and date at the end of every interaction and confirm it in writing.
Detect broken commitments from the calendar and CRM.
Clarity email draft for owner approval.
Close lost with reason(s) (multi-select, unknown allowed) and notes.
Schedule permitted re-engagement as a new opportunity.
List levers and owner priorities (cash up front, then term, then price).
Concede one step at a time; always trade.
Compute effective price and premium in code.
dependencies: Deals carry next step + date (convex/crm.ts nextStep/nextStepAt exist)
Owner-approved price rules; the AI never invents a discount

cash_and_labor_requirements.capability: CRM with next step/date and lost reason
cash_and_labor_requirements.measurement: deals without next step; broken-commitment count

metrics: share of open deals with a dated next step
deals closed lost per month by reason
guardrails: No decoy proposal options; no inflated starting prices; no false urgency.
Re-contact after loss only with the buyer's permission.
Re-contact only with permission or a lawful basis (consent rules vary by country)
Breakup email: no guilt, no false deadline (sales-follow-up Never do)
No false urgency: 'price goes up' or 'limited start slots' only if true and in facts
Consumer contracts: check local cancellation and payment-term law
alternatives_when_constrained: No CRM use: a weekly 10-minute list review of open quotes with next-step dates
No price rules from owner: present list price and ask the owner before any concession
stop_conditions: Monthly: read lost reasons; recurring reason becomes a positioning, offer or targeting question
If average realised discount keeps rising, review list price and proof rather than conceding more
review_triggers: Owner's numbers or business type change
A dated benchmark this playbook mentions is superseded
Leaving dead deals open (inflates pipeline, wastes owner time)
Negotiating against yourself before the buyer asks

contextual_heuristic.rule: proposed: An open deal with no future dated next step is flagged 'uncovered' in the pipeline view and daily brief.
proposed: Two broken commitments trigger a suggested clarity email, owner-approved, then close-lost with reason if unanswered.

external_requirement.rule: proposed: Re-engagement of a lost or deferred deal requires buyer permission or a lawful basis recorded on the deal; no default 60-day re-contact.
proposed: Urgency statements (price rise, limited slots, offer end date) require a matching fact; otherwise the lint blocks them.

strategic_preference.rule: proposed: Every concession in a drafted negotiation reply is paired with something the client gives (volume, term, upfront payment, reduced scope).
proposed: Proposal options must each be a deliverable offer; no decoy options.

economic_feasibility.rule: proposed: Effective price, payment-term premium and margin after concession are computed in code and checked against the owner's price floor.

reconciliation_note: Rejects the book's steering options and inflated anchors (RECONCILIATION R16).
